rawInput.answer: Routes are registered via RouterGroup methods (GET/POST/etc. in routergroup.go) which call group.handle() → engine.addRoute() (gin.go:364), inserting the path into a per-HTTP-method radix tree (methodTrees, a slice of {method, *node} in tree.go) using node.addRoute/insertChild. Incoming requests are matched in Engine.ServeHTTP (gin.go:662) → handleHTTPRequest (gin.go:690), which finds the tree for the request's HTTP method and calls node.getValue(path, ...) (tree.go:418) to walk the radix tree and return matched handlers, path params, and trailing-slash/fixed-path redirect info; if no method/path matches, 405/404 fallback handlers are invoked.

rawInput.answer: During registration, node.insertChild (tree.go:288) splits a path at each ':name' wildcard via findWildcard, creating a dedicated child node of nType=param whose path field stores the wildcard string (e.g. ":name") and sets the parent's wildChild=true.
